description: Conversion of dwelling into two falts (1 X 3 bed and 1 X 2 bed); single and two storey side and rear extensions; parking; separate amenity space
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size: 11pt;"><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;">The proposed subdivision of the front/ side amenity space would visually break up the garden space and create an unnecessary compact space to the front, which would break up the well-spaced pattern of front gardens. The front garden will not be screened enough to protect the privacy of future occupiers of the first floor flat. Taken together, these deficiencies contribute to an unacceptable standard of residential accommodation. As such, the proposal is contrary to Policies D3 D (7) and (11) and D6 of the London Plan (2021); Policies DM1 and DM26 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013); the London Plan Guidance: Housing Design Standards (2023); and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></span></p>

<p style="padding: 0.75pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="height:13.1pt">The proposed development would fail to provide adequate quality of accommodation for the future occupiers of both proposed flats by providing a sub-standard bedroom for the first floor flat and inadequate storage for both flats. The resulting layout will be substandard and cramped form of accommodation that would be detrimental to the living conditions of future occupiers. As such, the proposal is contrary to Policies D3 D (7) and (11) and D6 of the London Plan (2021); Policies DM1 and DM26 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013); the London Plan Guidance: Housing Design Standards (2023); and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</span></span></span></p>
